These chains date comparison-bundle entries; they do not establish the focal bundle's chronology.

The retained conditional instructions do not establish their applicability conditions, and the explicit limits supply no chronological connection between bundles. Comparison-bundle dating therefore yields no warranted relative or absolute chronology for the focal bundle.
